acceptanceCriteria: batch-check over a branch that merged main containing an unsealed main-side commit either passes with that commit reported as main-admitted, or the carry convention is changed so such commits are sealed; test reproduces the 13e1b26d8 case
docs/DOGFOOD.md states which BASE a merged-forward lane uses and how main-side commits are treated
body: Observed 2026-10-16 in the #941 merge-forward lane (head a9a779e7a). `dogfood-batch-check` from a fresh clone against the lane BASE 257bea097 (merge-base with main) failed unbound-commits for 13e1b26d8 'Carry Tasks policy v11 (full-gate reusable) to main' (parent 85ba6321a), a commit on origin/main with no sealed CEM (policy-carry PRs ship without one by convention). Against BASE=f81114713 (the merge's main parent) the check passed (constituents=4, commits=14). Every lane that merges current main and checks against its original base will hit this. Related but distinct: V1-1208 (retroactive bindings). Expected: either main-side commits already admitted to main are not re-required by a branch's batch-check, or policy-carry commits carry a sealed CEM (or a recorded exemption class). Actual: unbound-commits refusal for a commit the branch did not author.
title: dogfood-batch-check fails unbound-commits on any branch that merges main past the unsealed policy-carry commit 13e1b26d8
